description: Try a saved plan approval again when it is waiting to start (its id is in investigations.list planApprovals). Returns the approval's current state and the reason when it still cannot start. start_anyway ends the case's stopped runs that have no checked result, recording this person, so the approved plan starts; an earlier run may already have made its changes. A run still working keeps blocking.

authorization.description: The operator's instruction to retry, retained in the audit event. This is context, not an identity attestation.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key when retrying the same change

start_anyway.description: The operator chose to start even though an earlier run stopped without a checked result.
